text: I find myself in a place of inquiry and innovation—a conference room and then an exhibit dedicated to research and development. The air is filled with purpose, ideas waiting to be born. I feel anticipation and curiosity amidst the quiet halls and bright displays, both nervous and inspired, as if each glass wall and colorful diagram offers me an invitation to reimagine what it means to connect, learn, and create. Surrounded by reminders of progress and human ingenuity, I sense a reflective optimism—the kind that whispers of a better future, shaped by thoughtful collaboration.
